span_id.description: Identifier for this probe invocation (Phase 1 lineage).

parent_span_id.description: span_id of the enclosing probe invocation, if any.

flow_id.description: Logical flow this trace participates in.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier shared across a request/operation.

entities.description: Business entities this trace relates to (explicit values supplied by the caller).

projections.description: Projection extraction results attached to this trace (Issue #146). Bounded, structured slices produced by a projection_spec — never the raw payload. shadow_* phases normally arrive on shadow results (Issue #150) but are accepted here for contract parity with the server model.

error.description: Non-fatal extraction diagnostic; set when extraction failed and fields/metrics/samples are empty.

input_capture.description: Structured, canonically JSON-encoded call arguments captured for replay (Issue #242 Phase A / #243; opt-in via @probe(replay_capture=...)). Values are JSON-native (null/bool/number/string/array/object with string keys). Non-JSON-native values use a reserved single-marker-key object keyed by "__probe__": tuple/set/frozenset -> {"__probe__": "tuple"|"set"|"frozenset", "items": [...]} (set items sorted by their canonical JSON serialization); bytes -> {"__probe__": "bytes", "b64": "<base64>"}; non-finite float -> {"__probe__": "float", "value": "nan"|"inf"|"-inf"}; a dict with non-string keys or one literally containing a "__probe__" key -> {"__probe__": "dict", "items": [[key, value], ...]} (so plain decoded objects never contain "__probe__" and decoding is unambiguous); any other value -> {"__probe__": "unsupported", "type": "<TypeName>"} — never the raw value or its repr. args/kwargs may each be the redaction mask string when a redact path masked the whole slot.

args.description: Encoded positional arguments (a string only when fully redacted).

kwargs.description: Encoded keyword arguments by name (a string only when fully redacted).

replayability.description: Deterministic structural classification of whether input_capture can mechanically restore the call inputs (finite set; direct structural checks only, no heuristics). null on pre-Phase-A traces and on components not opted into replay capture.

replay_reasons.description: Structural reason codes explaining a partial/unreplayable classification (finite set). Empty for replayable; null when replay capture is not opted in.

sdk_transport.description: Bounded queue/circuit-breaker loss summary acknowledged by the Control Server (Issues #272/#273).

environment.description: Optional deployment environment tag reported by the SDK (PROBE_ENVIRONMENT), e.g. 'production'. Null when unset (Issue #290 Finding 5) — never inferred.

git_sha.description: Optional deployed commit sha reported by the SDK (PROBE_GIT_SHA). Null when unset (Issue #290 Finding 5) — never inferred from the pinned analysis snapshot.
